The decisions of the Traffic Safety Committee are advisory to the City Council, and the City
Council will take formal action to approve or deny said decisions at their meeting on Tuesday,
February 24, 2015. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the Council
with their concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person must ask
the Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to “pull” the item from the
Consent Calendar for discussion.

Members of the audience are invited to address the Committee at this time on items that are not
otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Traffic Safety

unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action
arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

ACTION MEMO
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  February 11, 2015
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  7:30 PM

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Committee Members Beall, King, Leach, Vice-Chair Kao, and Chairman Buss
  present.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
 None

OLD BUSINESS
1. Malaga Cove Plaza Area Parking Issues

  a) Traffic Safety Committee member Leach moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member King) to recommend approval of actions A, B, C, E, F, G, I and J as identified in
  the staff report. The vote was 5 in favor.

  b) Traffic Safety Committee Member Beall moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member Leach) to recommend changing 12 of the existing 2-hour parking spaces located
  on the northerly parking aisle in Malaga Cove Plaza to 4-hour parking as identified in
  action D of the staff report. The modified parking spaces shall be the easternmost 12
  spaces. The vote was 5 in favor.

  c) Traffic Safety Committee member King moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  Vice-Chair Kao) to recommend that Staff develop a project to construct angle parking on
  Via Tejon east of Via Chico as identified in action H of the staff report. The vote was 4-1
  (Beall opposed).

  d) Traffic Safety Committee member Leach moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  Vice-Chair Kao) to recommend that Staff develop a project to install pedestrian level
  lighting in the Plaza area as identified in action K of the staff report. The

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, February 24, 2015.

Traffic Safety Committee  1  Planning & Building Director SR-L

   recommendation also included adding pedestrian level lighting on Via Tejon between Via
  Chico and Malaga Lane. The vote was 5 in favor.

NEW BUSINESS

2. Del Mar Way Parking Prohibitions

  Traffic Safety Committee Vice-Chair Kao moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member Leach) to recommend installation of “NO PARKING ANY TIME” restrictions on
  the west side of Paseo Del Mar (Del Mar Way) between Palos Verdes Drive West and the
  driveway to 720 Paseo Del Mar. The vote was 5 in favor.

RESIDENT LETTERS
3. Palos Verdes Drive West and Via Pacheco Parking Restrictions – Flaurel English

  Action: Traffic Safety Committee Chair Buss directed Staff to review traffic conditions
  and report back to the Committee.
